display_long_description:
Enter a fast-paced VR adventure where every run is a test of speed, timing and reflexes. Guide your character through colorful streets, busy marketplaces, rooftops and obstacle-filled paths while collecting coins and chasing high scores.
Adventure Dash VR: Obstacle Run combines arcade action, platforming and runner-style gameplay in an immersive third-person VR experience. Dodge barriers, leap across platforms, weave through narrow streets and react quickly as the course puts your skills to the test.
FEATURES
• Fast-paced obstacle running and arcade action
• Challenging paths with jumps, hazards and obstacles
• Coin collection and score-based gameplay
• Colorful Middle Eastern-inspired city environments
• Increasing difficulty and reflex-based challenges
Run farther. Dodge faster. Collect coins. Master the course and push your high score.
Made for players who enjoy VR adventure games, arcade games, platformers, obstacle courses, running games and quick reflex challenges.
